dataset.state_selection: 20 legal Macro states per realization nearest to 5%-95% episode slot targets
dataset.k8_selection: 4 of 20 selected states per realization at evenly spaced time quantiles

teacher.expected_update_candidate_policy: Legacy V14b cache-scorer categorical conditioned on UPDATE, excluding candidate 0 then renormalized
teacher.duration_enumeration: exact for KEEP and every sampled UPDATE candidate
teacher.common_random_numbers: snapshot/restore with a deterministic exogenous stream shared by KEEP and UPDATE at each duration
teacher.single_sample_duration: sampled from the frozen Duration policy conditional on sampled UPDATE candidate; paired KEEP uses the same L

expected_teacher_stability.sign_agreement_definition: fraction of the 40 prespecified states with equal sign(DELTA_EXPECTED_K4) and sign(DELTA_EXPECTED_K8)

classifier_a_single_sample.loss: 0.5 * mean KEEP CE + 0.5 * mean UPDATE CE
classifier_a_single_sample.split_method: Frozen Trigger Separability Probe realization-grouped 5-fold 8/2 assignment
classifier_a_single_sample.normalization: raw 400d train-fold observations only; includes train TIE/UNCERTAIN rows

classifier_b_expected_option.loss: 0.5 * mean KEEP CE + 0.5 * mean UPDATE CE
classifier_b_expected_option.split_method: Frozen Trigger Separability Probe realization-grouped 5-fold 8/2 assignment
classifier_b_expected_option.normalization: raw 400d train-fold observations only; includes train TIE/UNCERTAIN rows
